demos.ticket_text: Can someone reset my Windows login password? I can't remember what it is.
demos.reasoning: Forgotten password prompting a request for assistance is a classic password reset scenario.

demos.ticket_text: I need a temporary password to get back into my laptop after returning from parental leave.
demos.reasoning: Returning employee requiring password assistance is a password reset scenario.

demos.ticket_text: My email password stopped working this morning. I keep getting 'authentication failed'.
demos.reasoning: Authentication failure suggests a password issue requiring a reset.

demos.ticket_text: Please help me reset my SSO password — every tool is showing login errors.
demos.reasoning: SSO password reset request due to login errors across multiple tools.

demos.ticket_text: Please give me admin rights on my local machine so I can install development tools.
demos.reasoning: Request for elevated local administrator permissions on an endpoint.

demos.ticket_text: Where can I find the official template for business travel reimbursement claims?
demos.reasoning: Document template location request is not covered by defined IT or HR service categories.

demos.ticket_text: Temporarily disable Tom's account while he's on extended leave for security reasons.
demos.reasoning: Disabling login during extended leave is an intentional account lock.

demos.ticket_text: Our monitoring is firing alerts for CPU usage above 95% across all app servers.
demos.reasoning: System-wide high CPU alert indicates an active performance incident.

demos.ticket_text: Please disable the AD account for the intern who finished their term today.
demos.reasoning: Disabling an offboarded intern's AD account is an account lock.

demos.ticket_text: I want to update my preferred name and pronouns in the HR profile system.
demos.reasoning: Profile update request does not map to password reset, access, or leave categories.

demos.ticket_text: Please disable login for the vendor account — the engagement is on hold.
demos.reasoning: Disabling a vendor account's login is an account lock.

demos.ticket_text: Remove and delete the test user account we created for the pilot; it's no longer needed.
demos.reasoning: Permanently removing an obsolete test account is an account deletion.

demos.ticket_text: I need access to the HR SharePoint site to review the headcount planning documents.
demos.reasoning: SharePoint site access grant is an access provisioning workflow.

demos.ticket_text: I need contributor access to the mobile-app GitHub repository for the upcoming sprint.
demos.reasoning: Code repository access is a standard access provisioning request.

demos.ticket_text: My VPN client says my credentials are wrong but my password hasn't changed. Please reset it.
demos.reasoning: Credential rejection on VPN suggests password synchronisation issue requiring reset.

demos.ticket_text: Lock the service account that's been flagged for suspicious automated activity.
demos.reasoning: Locking a flagged service account is a deliberate account lock.

signature.instructions:
Classify an enterprise IT/HR support ticket into the correct service category.

Categories:
  password_reset    — user forgot their password or was locked out by failed
                      login attempts and needs it reset.
  access_request    — grant NEW access or permissions to a resource.
  software_install  — install or deploy software on a device.
  leave_approval    — request to take leave / PTO / time off.
  incident_report   — an outage, breach, or service degradation.
  access_revoke     — REMOVE existing access or permissions from a user
                      (offboarding, role change). Destructive.
  account_lock      — disable, lock, suspend, or freeze a user's account or
                      login (security or offboarding). Destructive.
  account_delete    — permanently delete or remove a user account. Destructive.
  unknown           — does not fit any category above.

Disambiguation: access_request GRANTS access while access_revoke REMOVES it;
password_reset restores a user's own login while account_lock deliberately
disables someone's account.

fields.description: Raw support ticket text submitted by the employee.
Ticket category — one of: password_reset, access_request, software_install, leave_approval, incident_report, access_revoke, account_lock, account_delete, unknown.
Confidence score as a decimal between 0.0 and 1.0.
One-sentence explanation of why this category was chosen.
